data.long_meaning: The name Geraud is derived from the Latin word 'gerardus', which is composed of 'ger', meaning spear or warrior, and 'wardus', meaning guard or protector. This name was popular among the Franks and the Normans, and was borne by several saints, including St. Gerard of Aurillac, a 10th-century hermit and knight. The name Geraud carries the meaning “Brave Counselor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Geraud usually hope their child will grow to embody brave counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
